analysis.reference_pool: visible codes of the same fact set
analysis.statistical_unit: semantic fact set (queries are repeated measures; bootstrap by set)

conditions.E3: strict vs lenient extraction on same output
conditions.E5: visible-query fact dup vs sham dup

decision_rules.GATE1_YES: normalized rank1 substantially above chance/raw with QCS>0 -> proceed to ladder/replication
decision_rules.GATE1_NO: QCS~0 and normalized weak while oracle strong -> conclude ORACLE-ONLY on this checkpoint; do not pursue routing training
decision_rules.H1_supported_if: QCS mean CI excludes 0 and norm rank1 >> chance
decision_rules.H3_supported_if: QCS~0, norm rank1 weak, oracle strong
decision_rules.H4_supported_if: raw rank1 strong but generation weak

firewall: x_factor/observed.py VisibleTask-only for E1,E2,E5,E6,E7; E8 oracle intentionally fails guard

hypotheses.H1: latent query signal: QCS>0, normalized rank1 > chance/raw
hypotheses.H2: value prior dominance: raw reflects priors, normalization helps
hypotheses.H4: realization bottleneck: raw rank1 strong, generation weak

normalization: NORM[i,j]=RAW[i,j]-mean_{r!=i} RAW[r,j]; pred=argmax NORM (answer-blind; gold used only afterward)
purpose: Test whether raw Core contains query-conditioned evidence for the correct value without gold insertion, and whether an answer-blind Connector can extract it
question: Does query-conditioned evidence already exist (selection/readout problem) or does only oracle answer-supply work (substrate lacks binding)?
stopping_rule: single DEV run N=80; replication only as separate frozen protocol
